reuseProtection.guardDescription: Walks every combination in the catalog that resolves (via its LevelModifier) to INTERMEDIATE_PROGRESSION_MODIFIER_V1 v2 and asserts DistanceFamily=TenK, RunsPerWeek=4, Experience=Intermediate, and combination key=TEN_K__4D__INTERMEDIATE. Fails the moment an unrelated combination family gains a reachable reference to this artifact.
reuseProtection.guardScope: Process A only (test, not a production runtime validator) — chosen over a new production CandidatePublishGraphValidator/TemplateCombinationValidator rule to avoid a broader architecture change for a boundary that has no current violation to protect against and only one artifact affected.
reuseProtection.priorWeakGuard: OnlyOneLevelModifierReferencesIntermediateProgressionModifierV1_OwnershipReuseBoundaryConfirmed (retained) only checks LevelModifier.Metadata.Key equality, which is trivially true regardless of combination family since the key is invariant across versions — insufficient alone, now supplemented by the new test.

levelGlobalOwnershipSafetyReasoning: Hard-stop condition 3 (level-global field that 'cannot safely represent the current TEN_K/INTERMEDIATE/4-day scope') does not apply: INTERMEDIATE_PROGRESSION_MODIFIER_V1 has exactly one referrer today, so its schema-level 'global' shape and its actual reuse boundary are identical. No narrower existing architectural owner (e.g. a combination-specific or weekly-structure-policy artifact type) exists in this repository to move these fields to, and inventing one would violate the instruction not to create a speculative subsystem.
implementationShapeSelected: Shape 1 — keep all surviving fields on ProgressionModifierDefinition/INTERMEDIATE_PROGRESSION_MODIFIER_V1, because their current actual reuse scope matches the artifact's boundary exactly.
mitigationForFutureGeneralizationRisk: Documentation added at three levels (XML doc comment on ProgressionModifierDefinition, DomainContentDecision entries AUD-331/AUD-334, and this ownership report) explicitly stating the TEN_K/INTERMEDIATE/4-day scope boundary and that MaximumHardSessionsPerWeek=1 / AllowSecondHardStimulus=false must not be silently assumed for any future 3-day, 5-day, or other-distance INTERMEDIATE combination that might later reference this same artifact key without new evidence.
